title: 选控
summary: 「做个选择器」只说了能点。先定选的是一个刻度、一段区间、按步加减、逐级路径，还是一段日期：尺子松手对齐，双端不交叉，下限禁用，换上级清空下级，止晚于起。
summaryEn: “Make a picker” only says something can be tapped. First decide whether this pick is one tick, a two-end span, a stepped count, a path, or a date range: snap the ruler, keep the thumbs apart, disable at the floor, clear children when the parent changes, end after start.
asks: 这一次是选一个刻度、一段区间、按步加减、逐级路径，还是一段日期？
asksEn: Is this pick one tick, a two-end span, a stepped count, a path, or a date range?

links.when: 选哪种选择器不是填还是选
links.whenEn: which picker is not fill versus pick

links.when: 尺子、双端、步进或整页逐级选，不是往下展开的提交模型
links.whenEn: a ruler, dual-end, stepper, or full-screen cascade is not a downward commit model

links.when: 横向尺子不是滚轮圆柱吸附
links.whenEn: a horizontal ruler is not drum-wheel snap
